justification: Changes how the page check decides a served rule's page. Not Critical: no data written by this PR. Not Minor: page links on served rules.

falsifiable_check.fails_when: Fails if a row printed on a later page of a repeated table is kept on the first page, or if reordered table cells or a near-identical copy lose their stored page.
falsifiable_check.external_authority: Georges River DCP 2021 Part 6.1 Building Envelope Summary Table: options 7a/7b printed on PDF page 47, checked by eye 2026-11-03.
falsifiable_check.observed_red: Turning off either change (header starts or rare-word check) fails the new test (1 failed).

pre_impl.existing_data: Rule 170845 was on_page at p45 though printed on p47; 2 Canterbury-Bankstown figure rules were unresolved on wrong pages.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: Repeated cells chained the whole table into one stretch, so only the first page was ever scored.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: No new file; one helper and one extra candidate rule in the existing locator.
pre_impl.external_source_error: None: reads cached PDFs; an unreadable PDF stays no_source.

functions.name: _better_elsewhere
functions.what: Says whether the stored page holds only a rule's common words while another place holds its rare ones.
functions.input: rule tokens, found places, document readings, stored page
functions.output: True when the stored page should not be kept
functions.if_none: Fewer than two rare words: returns False, old behaviour
functions.edge_cases: Vaucluse near-copy and reordered table cells still kept (existing tests)
functions.failure_mode: A false True moves a page; every move is listed in the dry-run CSV before --apply

functions.name: occurrences (opening-piece starts)
functions.what: Each place the rule's opening piece is printed also opens a candidate stretch.
functions.input: rule tokens and one document reading
functions.output: places with share, page and pages
functions.if_none: No hits: empty list as before
functions.failure_mode: More candidates can make a rule unresolved instead of moved, never silently moved

break_it.scenario: A row printed on page 3 of a 3-page table, stored on page 1
break_it.what_happens: The row's page link moves to page 3

break_it.scenario: A table row whose cells are printed out of order on its own page
break_it.what_happens: The row keeps its own stored page

break_it.scenario: Two sections with nearly identical wording on different pages
break_it.what_happens: Each copy keeps its own stored page
break_it.how: rare words are on both copies

verified: live dry run 57,300 rules: 23 page changes, 22 checked word by word
gaps: One City of Sydney move (258753, p9->10) has no public PDF link to check by hand

post_merge.action: python scripts/dcp_page_repair.py --apply (backs up; writes 129 rows, 23 page changes)
post_merge.manual_verify: dcp_page_repair.py --check prints OK; rule 170845 stays on page 47

real_layer_exempt.scripts/rule_page_locator.py: Exercised against the live PDFs in the dry run above; writes nothing
